verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents a RESTful API that covers a broad set of core UI functions: drafting, scheduling, sending and cancelling campaigns, campaign reports, webhooks, shopping carts and abandoned-cart automations, and bulk shop-data import. A CLI reaches subscribers, campaigns and automations. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, though, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage of websites/landing pages (incl. A/B tests and AI builder), booking/scheduling, custom reports and the email editors, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Push or pull data from our RESTful API.
Draft, schedule, send, and cancel email campaigns, plus retrieve campaign reports and link clicks.
Subscribe to MailerLite events such as subscriber and campaign changes, manage webhook URLs, and inspect deliveries.
Create, update, and delete shopping carts and trigger abandoned-cart automations.
manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from your terminal
